jobs.title: Sr. Product Analyst
jobs.description:
Where Ambition Meets Innovation

Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.

Job Overview:

LPL Financial is seeking a Senior Product Owner who will help lead a portfolio supporting the Trading organization’s Data Transformation and technology modernization initiatives. This role is responsible for maximizing product value by managing and prioritizing the product backlog, collaborating with stakeholders across business and technology teams, and ensuring solutions align with strategic objectives. The Senior Product Owner serves as the primary connection between business stakeholders and the Scrum Team, helping deliver impactful products that enhance operational efficiency and advisor experiences.

Responsibilities:
- Partner with stakeholders to understand and translate product strategy and business objectives into actionable product requirements.

- Collaborate with Product Managers to define and refine features aligned to portfolio goals and roadmap priorities.

- Break features into user stories and prioritize the product backlog to maximize business value.

- Serve as the primary liaison between Scrum Teams and business stakeholders.

- Facilitate collaboration across business and technology teams throughout the product development lifecycle.

- Communicate product status, priorities, and outcomes to stakeholders and manage expectations.

- Support the creation of acceptance criteria and contribute to establishing Definition of Ready and Definition of Done standards.

- Provide ongoing product guidance to Scrum Teams and actively participate in Agile ceremonies.

- Validate completed user stories and ensure acceptance criteria have been met.

- Lead product demonstrations and reviews to showcase delivered functionality and gather stakeholder feedback.

- Support Data Transformation and technology modernization initiatives within the Trading organization.

- Contribute to the governance and production of executive-level dashboards and key performance reporting.

- Establish and maintain effective working relationships with stakeholders across the organization.

- Provide product reporting and insights that support informed business decisions.

- Coordinate and monitor interconnected products, initiatives, and dependencies.

- Support portfolio reporting and related operational activities.

What Are We Looking For?

We are seeking professionals who pursue greatness , act with integrity , are driven to help our clients succeed , win together , and create and share joy . The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, collaborates effectively across teams, demonstrates strong client focus, and continuously seeks opportunities to improve processes, products, and outcomes.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience in product management, consulting, program management, or project management within financial services, fintech, or a related industry.

- 2+ years of experience in Capital Markets or Trading domains.

- 3+ years of experience serving as a Product Owner within Agile/Scrum environments.

- Experience managing and prioritizing product backlogs and translating business requirements into user stories.

- Experience collaborating with business and technology stakeholders to deliver technology solutions.

Preferences:
- Strong knowledge of Jira.

- Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) and/or Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO) certification.

- Bachelor’s degree.

- Experience working in fast-paced and evolving business environments.

Pay Range:
$80,752.00 - $134,518.00

Actual base salary varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. Additionally, LPL Total Rewards package is highly competitive, designed to support your success at work, at home, and at play – such as 401K matching, health benefits, employee stock options, paid time off, volunteer time off, and more. Your recruiter will be happy to discuss all that LPL has to offer!

Company Overview:
LPL Financial Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: LPLA) is among the fastest growing wealth management firms in the U.S. As a leader in the financial advisor-mediated marketplace(6) , LPL supports over 32,000 financial advisors and the wealth management practices of approximately 1,100 financial institutions, servicing and custodying approximately $2.3 trillion in brokerage and advisory assets on behalf of approximately 8 million Americans. The firm provides a wide range of advisor affiliation models, investment solutions, fintech tools and practice management services, ensuring that advisors and institutions have the flexibility to choose the business model, services, and technology resources they need to run thriving businesses. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com.

At LPL, independence means that advisors and institution leaders have the freedom they deserve to choose the business model, services, and technology resources that allow them to run a thriving business. They have the flexibility to do business their way. And they have the freedom to manage their client relationships, because they know their clients best. Simply put, we take care of our advisors and institutions, so they can take care of their clients.

jobs.title: VP Product Manager – Advisory Platforms
jobs.description:
Where Ambition Meets Innovation

Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.

Job Overview
LPL Financial is seeking a Vice President, Product Management for Advisory Platforms within LPL’s Wealth Management Products organization — one of the most visible groups in our firm. As a trusted business partner, you will drive outcomes, lead cross-functional teams, and contribute the deep, thoughtful analysis that enables our leadership team to make informed decisions across our advisory platforms.

The Advisory Platforms product area is centered on the end-to-end capabilities advisors use to run their advisory business and the vendor relationships that support them — platform functionality, advisor workflows, and the partner ecosystem behind them. You will drive PI deliverables for the domain, working directly with your aligned technology partners and delivery teams to plan, commit, and deliver against the roadmap. You will also partner extensively with adjacent teams, including Model Management, to align on prioritization and sequencing so shared capabilities are delivered with minimal impact to those teams’ own commitments.

You will collaborate on the strategy and vision for Advisory Platforms and own its implementation — translating agreed direction into roadmaps, requirements, prioritized backlogs, and delivered capabilities. Strategic direction is set in partnership with senior leadership and stakeholders; your accountability is making it real.

A key component of that vision is the build-out of LPL’s tax overlay capabilities — tax-aware and tax-managed portfolio services delivered through our advisory platforms and overlay partners. You will lead the product execution behind this build-out, from capability definition and vendor selection through delivery, advisor enablement, and scale.

To be successful, you should bring a strong understanding of how financial professionals run their practice with a focus on advisory business — centralized portfolio management team operations, UMA and managed account structures, the interactions between parties involved in account management, tax-sensitive portfolio management, and investment management administration. A consulting mindset, fluency in the financial services regulatory environment, and command of Agile product development are critical. You will lead interactions with advisors, business leads, internal cross-functional teams, and external vendors to drive key outcomes in support of our strategy.

Responsibilities
- Partner with leadership and stakeholders to shape the Advisory Platforms strategy and vision, and own the execution of that direction end to end.
- Translate agreed strategy into a 6–24 month roadmap with clear themes, expected outcomes, and value drivers, aligned with stakeholders and dependent teams.
- Lead the product execution of LPL’s tax overlay build-out as a key component of the Advisory Platforms vision — defining capability requirements, sequencing delivery, and driving the cross-functional work needed to bring tax-managed services to market at scale.
- Define the tax overlay capability set in partnership with advisors, Advisory Programs business stakeholders, the Overlay Portfolio Management Group (OPMG), and vendor partners — including tax-loss harvesting, gain/loss budgeting, transition management, wash sale handling, tax-aware rebalancing, and client-level tax preferences.
- Drive PI deliverables for the domain — partnering with aligned technology teams through PI planning, commitment, and execution to ensure objectives are clear, dependencies and risks are identified early, and delivery stays on track.
- Own the vendor relationships for assigned advisory platforms — leading evaluation and selection, roadmap alignment, performance management, escalations, and contract and scope discussions, including RFPs and build-versus-buy analysis.
- Partner across the advisory organization and supporting functions to design the end-to-end operating model for new and enhanced advisory capabilities, including the workflows, controls, and disclosures required to operate them at scale, engaging Legal, Risk, and Compliance early.
- Partner with adjacent teams, including Model Management, to align on prioritization, sequencing, and delivery of shared capabilities with minimal impact to their own commitments.
- Define and prioritize the capabilities advisors need to run their advisory business, working from validated advisor, field, Advisory Programs, and OPMG input, and drive enablement and adoption with field, marketing, training, and service partners.
- Lead cross-functional teams and drive outcomes without direct authority; make day-to-day scope and prioritization tradeoffs within agreed strategic direction and escalate cross-product, funding, and vision-level decisions with clear options and recommendations.
- Define KPIs and success metrics — including tax overlay adoption, asset growth, and advisor-facing outcomes — and create best-in-class reporting and presentations on strategic plays and growth initiatives that are SVP+, C-Suite, and Board ready.

What are we looking for?
We want strong collaborators who can deliver a world-class client experience. We are looking for people who thrive in a fast-paced environment, are client-focused and team-oriented, and execute in a way that encourages creativity and continuous improvement.

Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree in a related field; MBA or other advanced degree preferred.
- 10+ years of experience in product management, management consulting, investment management, or program and project management, preferably within financial services or a related FinTech firm.
- 5+ years leading cross-functional teams in an Agile environment, including experience driving PI planning and delivery with technology partners.
- 5+ years experience with advisory or managed account platforms — advisor workflows, trading and rebalancing, or UMA/SMA account structures.
- 5+ years experience with tax overlay, tax-managed, or tax-aware portfolio management capabilities strongly preferred — including tax-loss harvesting, transition management, or overlay management services.

Core Competencies
- Advisory Platform Expertise – Applies deep knowledge of advisory business, managed accounts, advisor workflows, and the regulatory environment.
- Execution Ownership – Converts agreed strategy into roadmaps, backlogs, PI commitments, and delivered capabilities on committed timelines.
- Tax Overlay & Tax-Aware Investing Knowledge – Understands tax-managed portfolio construction, harvesting, transition management, and the operational and regulatory implications of delivering them at scale.
- Vendor & Partner Management – Manages third-party platform relationships, roadmap alignment, performance, and escalations.
- Influence Without Authority – Aligns and mobilizes cross-functional teams; an expert consensus-builder across initiatives outside direct accountability.
- Agile Execution – Guides backlog management and PI delivery, enabling teams to deliver high-value solutions.
- Executive Communication – Expert written and oral communication; develops, presents, and gains approval on business cases and funding requests.
- Data-Driven Decision Making – Uses metrics, analytics, and insights to inform product and business recommendations.

What does your success look like in the first 90 days?
- Immersing yourself in the advisory platform landscape — the capabilities, vendors, team processes and tools, the industry, and our advisors.
- Developing a working command of our current and target-state tax overlay capabilities, including vendor landscape, gaps, and dependencies.
- Establishing working relationships with key vendor partners, your aligned technology teams, and adjacent internal teams, including OPMG and Model Management.
- Building a clear view of the current roadmap, PI commitments, dependencies, and risks, and confirming execution priorities with leadership.
- Bringing fresh perspective, ideas, and critical thinking to how our growing team operates — consistently asking questions and pushing for progress over perfection.

jobs.description:
Where Ambition Meets Innovation
Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.

Job Overview:
LPL Financial is seeking a strategic and intellectually curious Vice President, Product Strategy & Market Insights. This role will lead the development and operation of a recurring market intelligence capability that provides actionable insights on the evolving wealth management and advisor technology landscape. The position partners closely with product, strategy, and go-to-market teams to assess market trends, competitive dynamics, emerging technologies, and industry investment patterns. The successful candidate will translate complex market developments into clear recommendations that inform product positioning, roadmap prioritization, and strategic decision-making.

Responsibilities:
- Build and operate a recurring market intelligence capability that provides ongoing visibility into industry direction, platform trends, capability evolution, and competitive market shifts.
- Produce regular insight deliverables including competitive landscape assessments, capability deep-dives, benchmark analyses, and executive-level market briefings.
- Partner with product subject-matter experts to evaluate market developments, assess competitive positioning, and identify differentiation opportunities.
- Translate industry and market insights into actionable implications for product roadmaps, investment priorities, and build-versus-buy decisions.
- Maintain a comprehensive view of established competitors, emerging market participants, and new technology entrants.
- Track emerging technologies and advisor experience innovations, evaluating potential opportunities and risks for LPL’s platform and ecosystem.
- Establish repeatable research methodologies, information sources, and analytical frameworks that support a sustainable market insights function.
- Collaborate with product, strategy, and go-to-market stakeholders to incorporate market intelligence into planning processes and key business decisions.

What Are We Looking For?
We are seeking a professional who is motivated to pursue greatness , consistently act with integrity , and is driven to help our clients succeed . The ideal candidate values collaboration, strives to win together , and contributes to a culture that seeks to create and share joy while delivering meaningful business outcomes through informed strategic decision-making.

Requirements:
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Strategy, Technology, or a related field.
- 10+ years of experience in product strategy, product management, management consulting, market research, strategic insights, or a related discipline.
- Demonstrated experience synthesizing large volumes of information into concise recommendations that support business decisions.
- Experience evaluating product, platform, and technology capabilities to support strategic analysis and decision-making.
- Experience partnering with product and technical subject-matter experts to develop positioning and differentiation strategies.

Preferences:
- Track record of influencing product roadmap, investment, or strategic decisions through analysis and recommendations.
- Experience presenting insights and recommendations to senior leadership audiences.
- Experience building, organizing, and managing research sources and information repositories.
- Deep curiosity about market dynamics, advisor technology, and emerging trends in financial services.
- Experience within wealth management, brokerage, banking, fintech, or other highly regulated industries.
